Package com.kerosene.kfe.liquidity.adapters.out.persistence

Class KfeChannelRebalanceQueueService

java.lang.Object
com.kerosene.kfe.liquidity.adapters.out.persistence.KfeChannelRebalanceQueueService
@Service public class KfeChannelRebalanceQueueService extends Object
Durable queue for rebalance work after binary decision pass. Circular submission uses a durable identity and atomic fee settlement under a lease fence.

  • Method Details

    • enqueueIfAbsent

      @Transactional public Optional<KfeChannelRebalanceJobEntity> enqueueIfAbsent(UUID decisionId, String channelPoint, String peerPubkey, long estimatedCostSats, long expectedGainSats)
      Enqueues at most one PENDING/IN_PROGRESS job per channel point. Admission requires the profit wallet and performs a soft available-balance check for positive estimated cost without reserving funds; the worker reserves the fee budget when provider execution begins. Unique-key races reload the active job instead of producing a duplicate intent.
      Parameters:
      decisionId - passing policy decision that authorized this work
      channelPoint - channel being rebalanced
      peerPubkey - remote peer, if known
      estimatedCostSats - estimated structural cost in satoshis
      expectedGainSats - expected future gain in satoshis
      Returns:
      existing active job, new PENDING job, or empty when profit funds are insufficient
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - when channel point is blank
